analyzed_vuln.description: FieldFromFlatbuffer dereferences field->name() in the dictionary-encoded branch without a null check: `field->name()->str()` at metadata_internal.cc:805. For malformed Flatbuffer metadata, `name` can be null, causing Flatbuffers `String::str()` / `Vector::size()` to read through an invalid pointer and crash (ASan SEGV in flatbuffers.h). The non-dictionary branch has a null check, but the dictionary branch does not.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: In arrow-ipc-stream-fuzz, attacker-controlled IPC stream bytes are parsed as Flatbuffer schema in GetSchema -> FieldFromFlatbuffer. If a Field has a non-null dictionary encoding (so execution enters the dictionary branch) and a null/invalid name pointer, the code calls `field->name()->str()` unconditionally, triggering an invalid read in Flatbuffers. Thus crafted schema metadata with dictionary field + missing/corrupt name is sufficient to crash.
